Claim amended · 2026-11-02T08:02Z · after the dev's audit (run record `/mnt/project-files/issue-29076/run-record-before.md`, a production Console build on the showcase and CRM, 375 and 390 px). This sets the fix surface and adds to the round 19 claim 6571189550 on this card. Branch, session and size are unchanged.

- **Measured:** no page scrolls sideways, mark-read and opening the target record work, and the popover opens in 308 to 448 ms at CPU 4x. FAIL: the inbox popover is `w-96` (384 px) and is clipped 9 px at 375 px, cutting the Activity tab, Mark all read and the group Mark read. It fits at 390 px with no margin. Popover controls are under 44 px: Mark all read 71x16, tabs 28 tall, Unread/All 24, View all notifications 16, View approvals 36, Open Approvals Inbox and View all activity 16. The account menu's notification switches are 44x24 at both widths. Rows pass at 75 px.
- **File surface (set):** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx`: width `min(24rem, 100vw - 1rem)` plus collision padding; below `md`, the failing controls get a 44 px minimum height and the tab strip fits (icons hidden, `flex-1`). The bell trigger's class is #29075's and stays untouched here. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/NotificationPreferencesMenu.tsx`: each row becomes a label bound to its switch, 44 px tall below `md`; `switch.tsx` is untouched. New tests `layout/__tests__/InboxPopover.phoneWidth-29076.test.tsx` and `layout/__tests__/NotificationPreferencesMenu.phoneWidth-29076.test.tsx`, and a root `.changeset` (patch).
- **Serial:** #29075 also edits `InboxPopover.tsx` (the trigger class only). Whichever PR lands second merges main.
- **Routed elsewhere:** the bell's 32 px target goes to #29075. On the full inbox page, the list toolbar targets and a 367 to 495 ms first-scroll frame at CPU 4x go to #29074 (the generic list view).
- **Declarations:** Clause-② no (className, layout and label binding only; no prop, API or i18n key), Metadata-protocol none, unchanged.
